note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme (matches the 'Template Newsletter' draft and daily production drafts). Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners (no data-color on the cover section). Story sections use bold h2 headings (e.g. Products & Research, Industry & Funding, Models & Platforms). Sign-off paragraph + full-width 'Share AI Current' button ({{rp_referral_hub_url}}) at the end.
established_template.link_format: Source

ad_placement_learnings.one_primary_slot_per_post: A post has exactly ONE 'primary' ad slot. The top/first ad can be data-advertisement-kind=primary; every additional ad must be data-advertisement-kind=secondary (text-only, no logo) or save/edit fails with 'No primary ad slot available'.
ad_placement_learnings.empty_creative_variations: An offer with empty creative_variations (e.g. Attio in this run) has no primary creative and cannot be embedded as primary; skip it or it errors.
ad_placement_learnings.accept_one_at_a_time: Embedding multiple FRESH available_offers in a single save_post is atomic and can trip 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Safer pattern: create the draft WITHOUT ad nodes first, then add each ad in a separate edit_post_content call (one opportunity per call). This also keeps a complete draft even if an ad fails.
ad_placement_learnings.recipients: Publication has no paid tier; posts default to free tier on web + email (omit recipients on save_post).
